hold_text: Dispatch instruction for lane E42, verbatim: 'TIER 2 -- it changes the runtime path that decides what the live trader fetches every tick. landing: "hold", hold_reason: "tier_2_3_needs_approval". Open a DRAFT PR. Do not merge, do not deploy, do not subscribe to your own PR.'

Both are on the live runtime path. The change is proven purely ADDITIVE -- measured over the checked-in config the global fetch set is 23 symbols before and the same 23 after, and supported_symbols is 24 before and 24 after -- so no leg that trades today can stop trading. That makes it low-risk, not Tier-1: the tier is set by which path is touched, not by the measured blast radius. config/accounts.yaml is edited COMMENT-ONLY (parsing both sides of the diff yields identical YAML); no roster, no mode:, no execution: and none of the 21 orphan pull-list symbols are touched.
